instruction: Candid dance studio photograph, medium-full shot. In a bright dance studio with a white floor and a window in the background, two young dancers pose. In the foreground, the blonde girl (R3) in a beige long-sleeve top, shorts, and white socks kneels on one knee with her arms gracefully raised. Behind her, the dark-haired girl (R6) in a matching beige outfit and white socks performs the same kneeling pose. Soft daylight from the window illuminates the clean, neutral-toned space.
